data.long_description:
Experience modern beachfront living in this beautifully furnished 1-bedroom apartment in Beach Vista, Emaar Beachfront.

This vacant unit is ready for immediate occupancy and offers a bright, well-designed layout with high-quality furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows that create a seamless flow of natural light. Perfectly suited for end-users or investors, the apartment combines comfort, style, and a prime waterfront lifestyle.

Property Features:
• 1 Bedroom
• Fully Furnished
• Vacant and Ready to Move In
• Bright Open-Plan Living Area
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
• Modern Fully Equipped Kitchen
• Built-in Wardrobes
• Premium Emaar Finishes
• Balcony with Community / Partial Sea Views

Residents of Beach Vista enjoy exclusive access to private beachfront, an infinity pool overlooking the sea, a fully equipped gym, landscaped leisure areas, and 24/7 security and concierge services.

Ideally located between Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, Emaar Beachfront offers a rare blend of island tranquility and city convenience, with world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment just minutes away.

A perfect opportunity for those seeking a turnkey beachfront home or a high-demand rental investment in one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront communities.
